integrity: Coefficient identities checked by two exact polynomial methods; reviewer assessment is self-review only. The date records the verified public arXiv submission of a supporting methodological source, not first discovery of the underlying cover or its theory.
scientific_limitations: Only the four-point family with ramification exponents (1,1,6,6) over an algebraic closure of characteristic five is classified. No full Newton polygon, complete Ekedahl–Oort type, or general curve-isomorphism classification is claimed. Full historical priority is unverified.
title: Characteristic-five zero-rank strata and Cartier strings in a cyclic septic four-point family
